mu-team-spin-left.label: LSG spin economy against left-handers
mu-team-spin-left.query: SELECT CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (13) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, bw.name bowler, bt.name batter, (d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) r, CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END b, CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END w FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players bw ON bw.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN players bt ON bt.player_id = d.batter_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022
